title: Lemon Herb Roasted Chicken
description: Juicy whole roasted chicken with fresh herbs and bright lemon
ingredients: 1 whole chicken 4 lbs|2 lemons sliced|4 cloves garlic smashed|3 tbsp olive oil|2 tbsp fresh rosemary|2 tbsp fresh thyme|1 tbsp fresh parsley|salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Preheat oven to 425F. Pat chicken dry. Mix olive oil with herbs, salt, and pepper. Rub all over chicken and under skin. Stuff cavity with lemon slices and garlic. Roast 60-75 minutes until juices run clear. Rest 10 minutes before carving.

title: Classic Beef Tacos
description: Seasoned ground beef in crispy shells with all the fixings
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef|1 packet taco seasoning|8 taco shells|1 cup shredded cheddar|1 cup shredded lettuce|2 tomatoes diced|1/2 cup sour cream|1/4 cup salsa|1 avocado sliced
instructions: Brown beef in skillet over medium-high heat, breaking up as it cooks. Drain fat. Add taco seasoning and 1/4 cup water, simmer 5 minutes. Warm taco shells per package directions. Fill shells with beef and top with cheese, lettuce, tomato, sour cream, salsa, and avocado.

title: Creamy Tuscan White Bean Soup
description: Hearty white bean soup with kale and sun-dried tomatoes
ingredients: 2 cans white cannellini beans drained|4 cups vegetable broth|3 cups chopped kale|1/3 cup sun-dried tomatoes chopped|4 cloves garlic minced|1 onion diced|2 tbsp olive oil|1 tsp Italian seasoning|1/4 tsp red pepper flakes|salt and pepper|parmesan for serving
instructions: Heat oil in large pot over medium heat. Sauté onion 5 minutes until soft. Add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook 1 minute. Add beans, broth, sun-dried tomatoes, and Italian seasoning. Simmer 15 minutes. Stir in kale and cook until wilted, 3-4 minutes. Season and serve with parmesan.

title: Teriyaki Salmon Bowls
description: Glazed teriyaki salmon over steamed rice with cucumber and edamame
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets 6 oz each|1/4 cup soy sauce|2 tbsp honey|1 tbsp rice vinegar|1 tsp sesame oil|1 tsp grated ginger|2 cups cooked white rice|1 cup edamame shelled|1 cucumber sliced|2 green onions sliced|sesame seeds
instructions: Mix soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, sesame oil, and ginger for teriyaki sauce. Marinate salmon 15 minutes. Heat skillet over medium-high heat. Cook salmon 4-5 minutes per side, brushing with extra sauce. Serve over rice with edamame, cucumber, and green onions. Garnish with sesame seeds.

title: Veggie-Packed Frittata
description: Fluffy baked egg frittata loaded with colorful vegetables and feta
ingredients: 8 large eggs|1/2 cup milk|1 cup cherry tomatoes halved|1 cup baby spinach|1/2 cup bell pepper diced|1/2 cup mushrooms sliced|1/3 cup crumbled feta|2 tbsp olive oil|salt and pepper|fresh basil for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 375F. Beat eggs with milk, salt and pepper. Heat oil in oven-safe skillet over medium heat. Sauté bell pepper and mushrooms 5 minutes. Add spinach and cook until wilted. Pour egg mixture over vegetables. Top with tomatoes and feta. Transfer to oven and bake 18-20 minutes until set.

title: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork
description: Tender fall-apart pulled pork with smoky barbecue flavors
ingredients: 3 lbs pork shoulder|1 cup barbecue sauce|1/2 cup chicken broth|2 tbsp brown sugar|1 tbsp smoked paprika|1 tbsp garlic powder|1 tsp onion powder|1 tsp cumin|salt and pepper|buns for serving
instructions: Mix brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin, salt and pepper. Rub all over pork. Place in slow cooker with broth. Cook on low 8 hours or high 4-5 hours. Shred meat with two forks. Stir in barbecue sauce. Serve on buns.

title: Shrimp Stir Fry with Vegetables
description: Quick and colorful shrimp stir fry with snap peas and bell peppers
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp peeled and deveined|2 cups snap peas|2 bell peppers sliced|3 cloves garlic minced|1 tbsp grated ginger|3 tbsp soy sauce|1 tbsp oyster sauce|1 tbsp sesame oil|2 tbsp vegetable oil|cooked rice for serving
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in wok or large skillet over high heat. Add shrimp and cook 2-3 minutes until pink. Remove and set aside. Add more oil, stir fry peppers and snap peas 3-4 minutes. Add garlic and ginger, cook 30 seconds. Return shrimp to pan. Add soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil. Toss well and serve over rice.

title: Black Bean Enchiladas
description: Cheesy vegetarian enchiladas stuffed with black beans and corn
ingredients: 2 cans black beans drained|1 cup frozen corn thawed|1 cup salsa|2 tsp cumin|1 tsp chili powder|8 flour tortillas|2 cups enchilada sauce|2 cups shredded Mexican blend cheese|1/2 cup sour cream|fresh cilantro
instructions: Preheat oven to 375F. Mix beans, corn, salsa, cumin and chili powder. Spread 1/2 cup enchilada sauce in baking dish. Fill tortillas with bean mixture and cheese, roll up and place seam-side down. Pour remaining sauce over top, add remaining cheese. Bake 25 minutes until bubbly. Top with sour cream and cilantro.

title: Greek Quinoa Salad
description: Fresh and filling quinoa salad with classic Greek flavors
ingredients: 2 cups cooked quinoa|1 cup cherry tomatoes halved|1 cucumber diced|1/2 red onion diced|1/2 cup kalamata olives|1/2 cup crumbled feta|1/4 cup fresh parsley|3 tbsp olive oil|2 tbsp lemon juice|1 tsp dried oregano|salt and pepper
instructions: Cook quinoa per package directions and let cool. Combine all vegetables in large bowl. Add cooled quinoa and toss. Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, salt and pepper for dressing. Pour over salad and toss to combine. Top with feta and parsley. Serve immediately or chill up to 4 hours.

title: Chicken and Vegetable Soup
description: Comforting homemade chicken soup loaded with vegetables and noodles
ingredients: 2 lbs bone-in chicken thighs|3 carrots sliced|3 celery stalks sliced|1 onion diced|3 cloves garlic minced|6 cups chicken broth|2 cups egg noodles|2 tbsp olive oil|1 tsp dried thyme|1 bay leaf|salt and pepper|fresh parsley
instructions: Heat oil in large pot. Brown chicken 5 minutes per side, remove. Sauté onion, carrots and celery 5 minutes. Add garlic, cook 1 minute. Add broth, chicken, thyme, and bay leaf. Simmer 30 minutes. Remove chicken, shred meat. Return to pot with noodles, cook 8 minutes. Season and garnish with parsley.

title: Mushroom Risotto
description: Rich and creamy arborio rice with mixed mushrooms and parmesan
ingredients: 1.5 cups arborio rice|4 cups mixed mushrooms sliced|5 cups warm chicken or vegetable broth|1 onion finely diced|3 cloves garlic minced|1/2 cup dry white wine|1/2 cup parmesan grated|3 tbsp butter|2 tbsp olive oil|fresh thyme|salt and pepper
instructions: Heat oil and 1 tbsp butter in large pan. Sauté mushrooms until golden, set aside. In same pan cook onion 5 minutes. Add garlic and rice, stir 2 minutes. Add wine, stir until absorbed. Add broth one ladle at a time, stirring constantly until absorbed before adding more. This takes about 20 minutes. Stir in mushrooms, remaining butter, and parmesan. Season and serve.

title: Honey Garlic Pork Chops
description: Pan-seared pork chops with a sticky honey garlic glaze
ingredients: 4 bone-in pork chops|4 cloves garlic minced|3 tbsp honey|2 tbsp soy sauce|1 tbsp apple cider vinegar|2 tbsp butter|1 tbsp olive oil|salt and pepper|fresh thyme
instructions: Season pork chops with salt and pepper. Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear chops 4-5 minutes per side until golden. Remove from pan. Reduce heat to medium, add butter and garlic, cook 1 minute. Add honey, soy sauce, and vinegar, simmer 2 minutes until thickened. Return chops to pan and spoon sauce over them. Cook 2 more minutes.

title: Lentil and Sweet Potato Curry
description: Warming vegan curry with red lentils and sweet potato in coconut milk
ingredients: 1 cup red lentils|2 medium sweet potatoes cubed|1 can coconut milk|1 can diced tomatoes|1 onion diced|3 cloves garlic minced|1 tbsp grated ginger|2 tbsp curry powder|1 tsp cumin|1 tsp turmeric|2 tbsp coconut oil|salt|cilantro and rice for serving
instructions: Heat oil in large pot over medium heat. Sauté onion 5 minutes. Add garlic, ginger, curry powder, cumin, and turmeric, cook 2 minutes. Add sweet potatoes, lentils, coconut milk, tomatoes, and 1 cup water. Simmer 25 minutes until lentils and sweet potato are tender. Season with salt. Serve over rice with cilantro.

title: BLT Pasta Salad
description: Creamy pasta salad with bacon
ingredients: lettuce
instructions: and tomato in a tangy dressing
prep_time_minutes: 3 cups cooked rotini pasta|6 strips bacon cooked and crumbled|2 cups romaine lettuce chopped|1 cup cherry tomatoes halved|1/2 cup mayonnaise|2 tbsp sour cream|1 tbsp lemon juice|1 tsp garlic powder|salt and pepper
cook_time_minutes: Cook pasta and let cool completely. Whisk mayo, sour cream, lemon juice, garlic powder, salt and pepper for dressing. Toss pasta with dressing. Add bacon, tomatoes, and lettuce. Toss gently to combine. Serve immediately or refrigerate up to 2 hours before serving.

title: Baked Cod with Lemon Butter
description: Flaky baked cod fillets with a bright lemon butter herb sauce
ingredients: 4 cod fillets 6 oz each|4 tbsp butter|2 lemons juiced and zested|3 cloves garlic minced|2 tbsp fresh parsley|1 tbsp fresh dill|salt and pepper|capers optional
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F. Place cod in baking dish. Melt butter and mix with lemon juice, zest, garlic, and herbs. Pour over cod. Season with salt and pepper. Bake 15-18 minutes until fish flakes easily. Garnish with capers and extra parsley.

title: Avocado Toast with Poached Egg
description: Creamy avocado on toasted sourdough topped with perfectly poached eggs
ingredients: 4 slices sourdough bread|2 ripe avocados|4 large eggs|1 lemon juiced|1/4 tsp red pepper flakes|salt and flaky sea salt|everything bagel seasoning|microgreens optional
instructions: Toast bread until golden. Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt. Bring pot of water to gentle simmer, add splash of vinegar. Crack each egg into small cup, swirl water and slide egg in. Poach 3-4 minutes for runny yolk. Spread avocado on toast, top with egg. Season with flaky salt, pepper flakes, and bagel seasoning.

title: Thai Peanut Noodles
description: Cold sesame noodles with creamy peanut sauce and fresh vegetables
ingredients: 8 oz rice noodles|1/3 cup peanut butter|3 tbsp soy sauce|2 tbsp lime juice|1 tbsp sesame oil|1 tbsp honey|1 tsp sriracha|1 tsp grated ginger|1 cup shredded purple cabbage|1 cup shredded carrots|1/2 cup edamame|chopped peanuts and cilantro
instructions: Cook noodles per package directions, rinse with cold water. Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, sesame oil, honey, sriracha, and ginger until smooth. Thin with 2-3 tbsp warm water. Toss noodles with peanut sauce. Top with cabbage, carrots, edamame, peanuts, and cilantro.

title: One-Pan Chicken Fajitas
description: Sizzling sheet pan chicken fajitas with colorful peppers and onions
ingredients: 1.5 lbs chicken breasts sliced|3 bell peppers sliced|2 onions sliced|3 tbsp olive oil|2 tsp cumin|2 tsp chili powder|1 tsp smoked paprika|1 tsp garlic powder|salt and pepper|flour tortillas|toppings of choice
instructions: Preheat oven to 425F. Toss chicken, peppers, and onions with oil and spices on large sheet pan. Spread in single layer. Roast 25-30 minutes until chicken is cooked and vegetables are charred at edges. Serve with warm tortillas and desired toppings.

title: Spinach and Ricotta Stuffed Shells
description: Jumbo pasta shells stuffed with creamy spinach ricotta filling in marinara
ingredients: 20 jumbo pasta shells|2 cups ricotta cheese|2 cups frozen spinach thawed and squeezed dry|1 egg|1 cup parmesan grated|2 cups shredded mozzarella|2 cups marinara sauce|2 cloves garlic minced|1/4 tsp nutmeg|salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 375F. Cook shells per package and let cool. Mix ricotta, spinach, egg, parmesan, garlic, nutmeg, salt and pepper. Spread 1 cup marinara in baking dish. Fill each shell with ricotta mixture and nestle into sauce. Top with remaining marinara and mozzarella. Cover and bake 30 minutes, uncover and bake 10 more minutes.

title: Cauliflower Fried Rice
description: Healthy low-carb fried rice made with riced cauliflower and vegetables
ingredients: 1 large head cauliflower riced|3 eggs beaten|1 cup frozen peas and carrots|1/2 cup edamame|3 cloves garlic minced|3 tbsp soy sauce|1 tbsp sesame oil|2 tbsp vegetable oil|3 green onions sliced|salt and pepper
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in large wok or skillet over high heat. Add garlic, cook 30 seconds. Add riced cauliflower, stir fry 5-6 minutes until slightly golden. Push to side of pan, scramble eggs in empty space, then mix in. Add peas and carrots, edamame, soy sauce, and sesame oil. Toss everything together. Top with green onions.

title: Beef and Broccoli
description: Classic takeout-style beef and broccoli in a savory brown sauce
ingredients: 1.5 lbs flank steak thinly sliced|4 cups broccoli florets|4 cloves garlic minced|1 tsp grated ginger|1/4 cup soy sauce|2 tbsp oyster sauce|1 tbsp cornstarch|1 tbsp sesame oil|2 tbsp vegetable oil|cooked rice for serving
instructions: Toss beef with cornstarch and 1 tbsp soy sauce. Heat oil in wok over high heat. Cook beef in batches 2-3 minutes, remove. Blanch broccoli 2 minutes, drain. Stir fry garlic and ginger 30 seconds. Add broccoli and beef back to pan. Mix remaining soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil, pour over. Toss and serve over rice.

title: Margherita Flatbread Pizza
description: Quick and delicious flatbread pizza with fresh mozzarella and basil
ingredients: 4 flatbreads or naan|1 cup crushed tomatoes|8 oz fresh mozzarella sliced|1/4 cup fresh basil leaves|2 tbsp olive oil|2 cloves garlic minced|salt and red pepper flakes
instructions: Preheat oven to 450F. Mix crushed tomatoes with garlic, salt, and red pepper flakes. Brush flatbreads with olive oil. Spread tomato sauce on each. Top with mozzarella slices. Bake 10-12 minutes until cheese is melted and bubbly. Remove from oven and immediately top with fresh basil. Drizzle with extra olive oil.

title: Turkey and Vegetable Meatballs
description: Lean turkey meatballs packed with hidden vegetables in marinara sauce
ingredients: 1.5 lbs ground turkey|1/2 cup grated zucchini squeezed dry|1/2 cup grated carrot|1/3 cup breadcrumbs|1 egg|3 cloves garlic minced|1/4 cup parmesan|2 tbsp fresh parsley|salt and pepper|2 cups marinara sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F. Mix turkey, zucchini, carrot, breadcrumbs, egg, garlic, parmesan, parsley, salt and pepper. Form into 1.5 inch balls. Place on lined baking sheet. Bake 20-22 minutes until cooked through. Serve with marinara sauce and pasta or zoodles.

title: Chickpea and Spinach Stew
description: Hearty Moroccan-spiced chickpea stew with wilted spinach
ingredients: 2 cans chickpeas drained|4 cups fresh spinach|1 can diced tomatoes|1 onion diced|4 cloves garlic minced|2 tsp cumin|1.5 tsp smoked paprika|1 tsp coriander|1/2 tsp cinnamon|2 tbsp olive oil|2 cups vegetable broth|salt and lemon juice
instructions: Heat oil in large pot over medium heat. Sauté onion 5 minutes until soft. Add garlic and all spices, cook 2 minutes. Add chickpeas, tomatoes, and broth. Simmer 15 minutes. Stir in spinach until wilted. Finish with lemon juice and salt. Serve with crusty bread or couscous.

title: Overnight Oats
description: No-cook creamy overnight oats with toppings for a quick breakfast
ingredients: 2 cups rolled oats|2 cups milk of choice|1 cup Greek yogurt|2 tbsp chia seeds|2 tbsp maple syrup|1 tsp vanilla extract|1 tsp cinnamon|toppings: fresh berries
instructions: banana
servings: Combine oats, milk, yogurt, chia seeds, maple syrup, vanilla, and cinnamon in large bowl. Stir well to combine. Divide into 4 jars or containers. Refrigerate overnight or at least 4 hours. In the morning, stir and add a splash more milk if too thick. Top with fresh fruit, nuts, and a drizzle of honey.

title: Grilled Halloumi Salad
description: Salty grilled halloumi over fresh greens with watermelon and mint
ingredients: 8 oz halloumi cheese sliced|4 cups mixed greens|2 cups watermelon cubed|1/2 cup cucumber sliced|1/4 cup fresh mint leaves|3 tbsp olive oil|2 tbsp lemon juice|1 tbsp honey|salt and pepper|pumpkin seeds for crunch
instructions: Heat grill pan or skillet over medium-high heat. Grill halloumi slices 2-3 minutes per side until golden grill marks appear. Arrange greens on platter. Top with watermelon, cucumber, and halloumi. Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, honey, salt and pepper for dressing. Drizzle over salad. Garnish with mint and pumpkin seeds.

title: Zucchini Noodles with Pesto
description: Light and fresh zoodles tossed in vibrant homemade basil pesto
ingredients: 4 large zucchini spiralized|2 cups fresh basil|1/3 cup pine nuts|2 cloves garlic|1/2 cup parmesan grated|1/3 cup olive oil|1 lemon juiced|salt and pepper|cherry tomatoes for serving
instructions: Blend basil, pine nuts, garlic, parmesan, lemon juice, salt and pepper in food processor. Stream in olive oil until smooth pesto forms. Spiralize zucchini into noodles. Heat large skillet over medium heat, add zoodles and cook 2-3 minutes just until slightly softened. Toss with pesto. Top with halved cherry tomatoes and extra parmesan.

title: Sheet Pan Sausage and Veggies
description: Easy weeknight sheet pan dinner with Italian sausage and roasted vegetables
ingredients: 4 Italian sausage links|2 cups broccoli florets|2 bell peppers cut into strips|1 zucchini sliced|1 red onion cut into wedges|3 tbsp olive oil|2 tsp Italian seasoning|1 tsp garlic powder|salt and pepper
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F. Slice sausages into coins or leave whole. Toss all vegetables with olive oil, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt and pepper. Spread on large sheet pan with sausage. Roast 25-30 minutes, tossing halfway, until vegetables are tender and sausage is browned.

title: Tofu Scramble
description: Savory high-protein tofu scramble seasoned like eggs with turmeric and veggies
ingredients: 1 block firm tofu pressed and crumbled|1 cup cherry tomatoes halved|1 cup baby spinach|1/2 bell pepper diced|1/4 onion diced|2 cloves garlic minced|1 tsp turmeric|1 tsp cumin|2 tbsp nutritional yeast|2 tbsp olive oil|salt and pepper
instructions: Heat oil in skillet over medium heat. Sauté onion and bell pepper 4 minutes. Add garlic, cook 1 minute. Add crumbled tofu, turmeric, cumin, nutritional yeast, salt and pepper. Cook 5-6 minutes, stirring, until heated through and slightly golden. Add spinach and tomatoes, cook until wilted. Serve with toast.

title: Chicken Caesar Wraps
description: Classic Caesar salad ingredients wrapped in a large flour tortilla
ingredients: 2 grilled chicken breasts sliced|4 large flour tortillas|4 cups romaine lettuce chopped|1/2 cup parmesan shaved|1/2 cup Caesar dressing|1 cup croutons|lemon wedges
instructions: Warm tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave. Toss romaine with Caesar dressing. Lay tortillas flat. Divide lettuce mixture among tortillas. Top with sliced chicken, parmesan, and croutons. Roll tightly, tucking in sides. Cut in half diagonally. Serve with lemon wedges.

title: Butternut Squash Soup
description: Silky smooth butternut squash soup with warming spices and cream
ingredients: 1 large butternut squash cubed|1 onion chopped|3 cloves garlic|2 cups vegetable broth|1 cup coconut milk|1 tbsp olive oil|1 tsp curry powder|1/2 tsp nutmeg|salt and pepper|pumpkin seeds and cream for serving
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F. Toss squash with oil, salt and pepper. Roast 30 minutes until tender. In pot, sauté onion and garlic 5 minutes. Add roasted squash, broth, curry powder, and nutmeg. Simmer 10 minutes. Blend until smooth. Stir in coconut milk. Adjust seasoning. Serve topped with pumpkin seeds and a swirl of cream.

title: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in spiced tomato and pepper sauce - a one-pan wonder
ingredients: 6 large eggs|2 cans diced tomatoes|2 bell peppers diced|1 onion diced|4 cloves garlic minced|2 tsp cumin|2 tsp paprika|1 tsp chili powder|2 tbsp olive oil|salt and pepper|feta and fresh herbs for serving
instructions: Heat oil in large oven-safe skillet over medium heat. Sauté onion and peppers 8 minutes. Add garlic and spices, cook 2 minutes. Add tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes until thickened. Make 6 wells in sauce. Crack eggs into wells. Cover and cook on low 8-10 minutes until whites are set but yolks are still runny. Top with feta and herbs.

title: Mango Chicken Lettuce Wraps
description: Fresh and light chicken lettuce wraps with tropical mango salsa
ingredients: 1.5 lbs ground chicken|1 mango diced|1 cup shredded carrots|1/2 red onion finely diced|1/4 cup fresh cilantro|2 tbsp lime juice|3 cloves garlic minced|2 tbsp soy sauce|1 tbsp fish sauce|1 tsp sesame oil|butter lettuce leaves
instructions: Cook ground chicken in skillet over medium-high heat 8-10 minutes until cooked through. Add garlic, soy sauce, fish sauce, and sesame oil. Cook 2 more minutes. Remove from heat. Mix mango, red onion, cilantro, and lime juice for salsa. Spoon chicken into lettuce leaves and top with mango salsa and carrots.

title: Caprese Stuffed Avocado
description: Creamy avocado halves filled with fresh caprese salad ingredients
ingredients: 4 ripe avocados halved and pitted|2 cups cherry tomatoes halved|8 oz fresh mozzarella balls|1/4 cup fresh basil|2 tbsp olive oil|1 tbsp balsamic glaze|salt and pepper|flaky sea salt
instructions: Arrange avocado halves on serving plate. Fill each with cherry tomatoes and mozzarella balls. Tuck basil leaves between ingredients. Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze. Season with salt, pepper, and flaky sea salt. Serve immediately.

title: Beef Bolognese
description: Rich slow-simmered meat sauce over pasta - an Italian classic
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef|1/2 lb ground pork|1 onion finely diced|2 carrots finely diced|2 celery stalks finely diced|4 cloves garlic minced|1 cup red wine|1 can crushed tomatoes|1/2 cup whole milk|2 tbsp olive oil|1 tsp dried oregano|salt and pepper|pasta and parmesan for serving
instructions: Heat oil in large Dutch oven over medium heat. Sauté onion, carrot, and celery 10 minutes. Add garlic, cook 2 minutes. Add beef and pork, brown 10 minutes. Add wine, simmer until evaporated. Add tomatoes and oregano. Simmer on low 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Stir in milk, simmer 10 more minutes. Season well. Serve over pasta with parmesan.

title: Salmon Nicoise Salad
description: Classic French salad with salmon
ingredients: green beans
instructions: potatoes
cook_time_minutes: 4 salmon fillets|1 lb baby potatoes halved|1 lb green beans trimmed|4 large eggs|1 cup cherry tomatoes|1/2 cup kalamata olives|4 cups mixed greens|3 tbsp Dijon mustard|3 tbsp red wine vinegar|1/2 cup olive oil|salt and pepper
servings: Boil potatoes 15 minutes until tender. Blanch green beans 3 minutes, plunge in ice water. Soft boil eggs 7 minutes, peel and halve. Season and pan sear salmon 4-5 minutes per side. Whisk mustard, vinegar, olive oil, salt and pepper for dressing. Arrange greens on platter, top with all components. Drizzle with dressing.

title: Vegetable Pad Thai
description: Classic Thai noodles with tofu
ingredients: crunchy peanuts
instructions: and tangy tamarind sauce
prep_time_minutes: 8 oz rice noodles|14 oz extra-firm tofu cubed|3 eggs beaten|2 cups bean sprouts|3 green onions sliced|3 cloves garlic minced|3 tbsp tamarind paste|3 tbsp soy sauce|2 tbsp fish sauce or soy sauce|1 tbsp sugar|2 tbsp vegetable oil|lime wedges and peanuts for serving
cook_time_minutes: Soak noodles in hot water 20 minutes, drain. Mix tamarind, soy sauce, fish sauce, and sugar for sauce. Heat oil in wok over high heat. Fry tofu until golden, set aside. In same wok, fry garlic 30 seconds. Add noodles and sauce, toss. Push to side, scramble eggs. Mix everything together. Add bean sprouts, green onions, and tofu. Serve with lime and peanuts.

title: Baked Falafel Bowls
description: Crispy oven-baked falafel over hummus with fresh toppings
ingredients: 2 cans chickpeas drained|1/2 onion roughly chopped|4 cloves garlic|1/2 cup fresh parsley|1/2 cup fresh cilantro|2 tsp cumin|1 tsp coriander|1/2 tsp cayenne|3 tbsp flour|salt|olive oil|hummus
instructions: cucumber
servings: Preheat oven to 400F. Pulse chickpeas, onion, garlic, herbs, and spices in food processor until coarse mixture forms. Add flour and salt, pulse again. Form into balls and flatten slightly. Place on oiled baking sheet. Brush with olive oil. Bake 25-30 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crispy. Serve over hummus with toppings.

title: Miso Glazed Eggplant
description: Japanese-inspired eggplant with sweet miso glaze - perfect as a side or main
ingredients: 4 Japanese eggplants halved|3 tbsp white miso paste|2 tbsp mirin|1 tbsp sake or rice wine|1 tbsp soy sauce|1 tbsp honey|1 tbsp sesame oil|sesame seeds and green onion for garnish
instructions: Preheat broiler. Score eggplant flesh in crosshatch pattern. Mix miso, mirin, sake, soy sauce, honey, and sesame oil for glaze. Brush cut sides of eggplant generously with glaze. Broil 8-10 minutes until soft and caramelized. Watch carefully to avoid burning. Garnish with sesame seeds and green onion.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Creamy and aromatic Indian chicken curry with tender marinated chicken
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breast cubed|1 cup plain yogurt|2 tbsp garam masala divided|1 tsp turmeric|1 can crushed tomatoes|1 cup heavy cream|1 onion diced|5 cloves garlic minced|1 tbsp grated ginger|2 tbsp butter|1 tsp cumin|1 tsp paprika|salt|rice and naan for serving
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, 1 tbsp garam masala, turmeric, and salt for 30 minutes. Cook marinated chicken in hot skillet until charred. Remove. In same pan melt butter, sauté onion 8 minutes. Add garlic, ginger, remaining garam masala, cumin, paprika, cook 2 minutes. Add tomatoes, simmer 10 minutes. Add cream and chicken, simmer 15 minutes. Serve with rice and naan.

title: Pesto Orzo with Roasted Tomatoes
description: Simple and vibrant orzo pasta with roasted cherry tomatoes and fresh pesto
ingredients: 2 cups orzo pasta|2 cups cherry tomatoes|1/2 cup basil pesto|1/2 cup fresh mozzarella pearls|1/4 cup pine nuts toasted|3 tbsp olive oil|salt and pepper|fresh basil for garnish
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F. Toss tomatoes with 2 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper. Roast 20 minutes until burst and caramelized. Cook orzo in salted boiling water until al dente, drain. Toss hot orzo with pesto and remaining olive oil. Fold in roasted tomatoes and mozzarella pearls. Top with pine nuts and fresh basil. Serve warm or at room temperature.

title: Korean Ground Beef Bowls
description: Quick and flavorful Korean-inspired beef over rice with pickled cucumbers
ingredients: 1 lb ground beef|1/2 cup soy sauce|3 tbsp brown sugar|1 tbsp sesame oil|4 cloves garlic minced|1 tsp grated ginger|1/4 tsp red pepper flakes|2 cups cooked rice|1 cucumber sliced|2 tbsp rice vinegar|1 tsp sugar|green onions and sesame seeds
instructions: Quick-pickle cucumber by tossing with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt, set aside. Brown beef in skillet over medium-high heat. Drain fat. Add garlic and ginger, cook 1 minute. Add soy sauce, brown sugar, sesame oil, and red pepper flakes. Simmer 3-4 minutes until sauce thickens. Serve over rice with pickled cucumbers, green onions, and sesame seeds.

title: Roasted Vegetable and Goat Cheese Tart
description: Elegant savory tart with colorful roasted vegetables and creamy goat cheese
ingredients: 1 sheet puff pastry thawed|1 zucchini sliced|1 cup cherry tomatoes|1 red pepper sliced|4 oz goat cheese|2 tbsp olive oil|2 tsp Italian seasoning|1 egg beaten|fresh thyme|salt and pepper|balsamic glaze for drizzling
instructions: Preheat oven to 400F. Toss vegetables with olive oil, Italian seasoning, salt and pepper. Roast 20 minutes. Unroll puff pastry on lined baking sheet. Score a border 1 inch from edge. Crumble goat cheese inside border. Arrange roasted vegetables over cheese. Brush border with egg wash. Bake 20-25 minutes until pastry is golden. Drizzle with balsamic glaze.

title: White Chicken Chili
description: Creamy and comforting white chicken chili with green chiles and beans
ingredients: 2 lbs chicken breast|2 cans white cannellini beans drained|1 can green chiles|1 onion diced|4 cloves garlic minced|4 cups chicken broth|1 cup sour cream|4 oz cream cheese cubed|2 tsp cumin|1 tsp chili powder|1 tsp oregano|salt|toppings: avocado
instructions: cilantro
cook_time_minutes: Place chicken, onion, garlic, chiles, broth, and spices in slow cooker. Cook on low 6-7 hours or high 3-4 hours. Remove chicken and shred. Return to pot. Stir in cream cheese and let melt, 15 minutes. Stir in sour cream and beans. Cook 20 more minutes on high. Serve with desired toppings.

title: Summer Corn and Zucchini Pasta
description: Light summer pasta with fresh corn
ingredients: zucchini
instructions: and lemon brown butter
prep_time_minutes: 1 lb linguine|3 ears corn kernels cut off cob|2 zucchini diced|4 tbsp butter|4 cloves garlic minced|1/2 cup parmesan|1 lemon juiced and zested|1/4 cup fresh basil|red pepper flakes|salt and pepper
cook_time_minutes: Cook pasta in salted water until al dente, reserve 1 cup pasta water. In large skillet, brown butter over medium heat 3-4 minutes until golden and nutty. Add garlic, cook 1 minute. Add corn and zucchini, cook 5 minutes. Add drained pasta, lemon juice, zest, and splash of pasta water. Toss to coat. Stir in parmesan and basil. Season with red pepper flakes, salt and pepper.

title: Seared Ahi Tuna Salad
description: Restaurant-quality seared tuna over Asian slaw with ginger dressing
ingredients: 2 ahi tuna steaks|4 cups shredded napa cabbage|1 cup shredded purple cabbage|1 cup edamame|1 cup shredded carrots|1 avocado sliced|2 tbsp sesame seeds|3 tbsp soy sauce|2 tbsp rice vinegar|1 tbsp sesame oil|1 tbsp honey|1 tsp grated ginger|2 tbsp neutral oil
instructions: Whisk soy sauce, rice vinegar, sesame oil, honey, and ginger for dressing. Toss cabbages, edamame, and carrots with half the dressing. Season tuna with salt and pepper. Heat neutral oil in very hot skillet. Sear tuna 60-90 seconds per side for rare. Slice thinly. Serve tuna over slaw with avocado. Drizzle remaining dressing and sesame seeds.

title: Breakfast Burritos
description: Hearty make-ahead breakfast burritos loaded with eggs
ingredients: sausage
instructions: and cheese
prep_time_minutes: 8 large eggs|1/2 lb breakfast sausage|1 cup shredded cheddar|1/2 cup diced bell pepper|1/4 cup diced onion|4 large flour tortillas|1/4 cup salsa|salt and pepper|hot sauce optional
cook_time_minutes: Cook sausage in skillet over medium heat, crumbling as it cooks. Remove and set aside. In same skillet, sauté pepper and onion 3 minutes. Beat eggs with salt and pepper, pour into skillet. Scramble over medium-low heat until just set. Remove from heat. Warm tortillas. Layer eggs, sausage, cheese, and salsa on each tortilla. Roll tightly. Serve immediately or wrap in foil to freeze.

title: Tuscan White Bean and Kale Pasta
description: Rustic Italian pasta with white beans
ingredients: kale
instructions: and sun-dried tomatoes
prep_time_minutes: 1 lb penne pasta|2 cans white beans drained|4 cups kale chopped|1/3 cup sun-dried tomatoes|6 cloves garlic minced|1/2 cup parmesan|1/4 cup olive oil|1/2 tsp red pepper flakes|1 cup pasta water|salt and pepper
cook_time_minutes: Cook pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, reserve 1 cup pasta water. Heat olive oil in large skillet over medium heat. Add garlic and red pepper flakes, cook 2 minutes. Add kale and sun-dried tomatoes, cook until kale wilts. Add beans and pasta water, simmer 5 minutes. Add drained pasta and toss well. Finish with parmesan, salt and pepper.
